DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The chest X-ray findings of a ground-glass appearance with air bronchograms, combined with the history of prematurity (32 weeks), C-section, and maternal gestational diabetes, are classic indicators for RDS.
